payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and processes for building gazetteer resources from Wikipedia and Wikidata, detailing the use of entity relationships, sitelink counts, and filtering techniques.

claims.text: Gazetteers can be built from Wikipedia by extracting relationships and using classical machine learning models, although the data is smaller and noisier compared to Wikidata.
Wikidata is preferred for building gazetteers due to its larger dataset of around 45 million entities and structured organization of entities and properties.
To extract gazetteers from Wikidata, official dumps are processed into tuples of entity and type, using sitelink counts to filter and prioritize types based on popularity.
